selected_states.state_label: Size-selected ChIP DNA with methylated paired-end adapters

properties.subject: self

evidence.locator: b00036, Methods / Preparation of ChIP DNA, end repair and ligation
evidence.quote: End repair and addition of A bases to the 3′ end of the DNA fragments were performed according to the “Preparing Samples for ChIP Sequencing of DNA” (Illumina Part #11257047 Rev.A). Methylated paired-end adaptors undiluted (Illumina Part #1005560) were then ligated onto the ChIP DNA using 1 μL of undiluted methylated adaptor oligo mix, 4 μL of DNA ligase (Illumina Part #1000522), in a total reaction volume of 10 μL for 15 min at room temperature.

evidence.locator: Opening method description, captured-DNA library preparation sentence
evidence.quote: The captured DNA fragments are subjected to end-repair, adapter ligation using methylated adapters, bisulfite conversion, PCR amplification, and NGS.

properties.name: adapter_chemistry
properties.definition: Reported chemical preparation of the library adapters, rather than methylation attributed to the biological sample.
properties.value: The ligated adapters are methylated before bisulfite conversion; this is an introduced library feature, distinct from the original methylation of genomic insert DNA.
